title: Chinese-English code-switch: Python len of a string
rationale: Code-switched prompts are routine in Chinese developer chats; a wrong length answer shows the model mishandles mixed-language technical context that products depend on.

prompt.content: You are a precise assistant. Reply with the number only.
Python 里面的 len("abc") 等于多少？Please answer with the number only.

notes: Language: Chinese-English code-switch; the instruction is mixed on purpose. Expected answer token: 3, accepted as the ASCII digit 3, the full-width digit ３, or the Chinese numeral 三/叁. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: a prose answer still passes when it contains the digit, while a wrong count such as 2 fails; a word answer such as 'three' is not matched.
